name: Dead Simple Email
description: Create Dead Simple Email inboxes and send, read, and reply to email.

credential_fields.name: token
credential_fields.label: API Key
credential_fields.description: Dead Simple Email API key from the Dead Simple Email dashboard.

tools.name: list_inboxes
tools.description: List inboxes available to this Dead Simple Email API key.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Next cursor from the previous response.

tools.name: create_inbox
tools.description: Create a Dead Simple Email inbox.

local_part.description: Local part of the new email address.

tags.description: Tags to attach to the inbox.

tools.name: get_inbox
tools.description: Get a Dead Simple Email inbox by ID.

inbox_id.description: Inbox ID returned by list_inboxes or create_inbox.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List messages in a Dead Simple Email inbox.

inbox_id.description: Inbox ID returned by list_inboxes or create_inbox.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Next cursor from the previous response.

labels.description: Comma-separated message labels to filter by.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Read a Dead Simple Email message by ID.

inbox_id.description: Inbox ID returned by list_inboxes or create_inbox.

message_id.description: Message ID returned by the provider.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email from a Dead Simple Email inbox. Provide text_body or html_body.

inbox_id.description: Inbox ID returned by list_inboxes or create_inbox.

to.description: Recipient email address or list of addresses.

reply_to.description: Email address that should receive replies.

tools.name: reply_to_message
tools.description: Send a threaded reply from a Dead Simple Email inbox. Provide text_body or html_body.

inbox_id.description: Inbox ID returned by list_inboxes or create_inbox.

message_id.description: Message ID returned by the provider.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Read a Dead Simple Email thread and its messages.

inbox_id.description: Inbox ID returned by list_inboxes or create_inbox.

thread_id.description: Thread ID returned by the provider.
